newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 3.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- China has raised a total of $4.0 billion from overseas sovereign bond issues since its return to the international debt markets in 1993.
- President Jiang Zemin says former paramount leader Deng Xiaoping's theory that science and technology are primary productive forces has been proven correct.
- China's Ministry of Finance expects warm reaction to issue of mark sovereign bonds, which will take place soon.
- China's mini-car market heads for oversupply in 1997, with production seen at 152,500 units and demand at just 120,000 units.
- Chinese and Hong Kong firms plan to build a 1.0 billion yuan bridge in Shantou in southern Guangdong province.
- China and Israel sign a memorandum of understanding on a joint venture to produce 800,000 tonnes of potassium chloride in far-western Qinghai province.
- Front-page article celebrates economic achievements of Hong Kong and says the territory's return to Chinese rule will boost prospects for economic cooperation between it China's interior.
